purpose: Machine-readable scope contract for AI agents working on the DS-Planning-Engine. Any AI agent invoked against this folder MUST read this file first (along with AGENTS.md) and obey it.
topLevelRule: This planning engine is DS-bound. Every section kind, archetype, motion preset, and theme it emits MUST exist in ../Frontend-Master_DS/generated/ds.contract.json. When the brief asks for something the DS does not expose, the planner records a gap in ds-gap-report.md and locks the plan with status: 'needs_ds_extension' — it MUST NOT invent a workaround.

locked.description: Source of truth. Agents MUST NOT edit. Edits require explicit human approval.

extensible.description: Agents MAY ADD NEW FILES that follow the documented convention. MUST NOT edit existing files in these paths.

consumable.description: Agents READ these to drive planning decisions. Reading is free; writing is forbidden.

runOutput.description: Per-invocation plan output. Planner WRITES here. Once a plan locks, the run folder is frozen — do not edit prior runs.

forbiddenActions: Inventing section kinds not present in ds.contract.json
Inventing motion presets not present in ds.contract.json
Inventing archetypes not present in ds.contract.json
Emitting a plan with lock_status: 'passed' when ds_gaps[] is non-empty
Modifying any file under ../Frontend-Master_DS/ (the DS is locked separately)
Adding new top-level dependencies without human approval
Emitting copy that contradicts the brief's voice or forbidden_words
allowedActions: Reading any file in the engine, in ../Frontend-Master_DS/, or in ../DOC/
Running the planner agent (DS_site_planner) via its documented invocation
Adding new industry pattern files under core/industry-patterns/ per the extension rule
Writing new run output under output/runs/<timestamp>-<project-slug>/

verificationGate.exitCode: 0 = plan ready for executor; non-zero = invalid
verificationGate.rule: DS_Frontend_developer MUST NOT be invoked against a plan that has not passed verify-plan.mjs.
